newsitem.title: USA: First Union merger plan gets regulatory OK.
newsitem.headline: First Union merger plan gets regulatory OK.

text.p: First Union Corp and Home Financial Corp said on Friday they received all necessary regulatory approvals to complete the merger of Home Financial into First Union Corp.
The effective date of the merger was scheduled for November 29, the companies said.

In June, First Union agreed to buy Home Financial via a stock swap. Under terms of the deal, 0.2233 shares of First Union common stock would be exchanged for each share of Home Financial common stock, subject to adjustment.

The companies said the record date for receiving First Union's fourth quarter dividend was also November 29 so if the merger was completed on that date, Home Financial shareholders would receive this dividend.
Completion of the merger was subject to the satisfaction of certain conditions, the companies said.
